labels.I: an expired or broken invitation reported and replaced
labels.R: decisions and news carried between the chat and the thread, in either direction, or to members outside the chat
labels.S: entry to the chat controlled: applicants screened, channels by role or flair, a member banned and unbanned
labels.C: the chat named as where the plan lives: a referral, a template held there, a catch-up on decisions made there, an offer to open one
labels.O: a way kept open for those who will not or cannot enter the chat (a public template, a subreddit, the thread)
